constraints.name: irreversible_dispute_action_second_actor

constraints.name: marketplace_terms_configuration_mode

constraints.name: payment_lifecycle_guards_payment_coherent

constraints.name: payments_actual_stripe_costs
constraints.expression: (((actual_stripe_charge_fee_amount >= 0) AND (actual_stripe_charge_fee_amount <= '9007199254740991'::bigint)) AND ((actual_stripe_refund_fee_amount >= '-9007199254740991'::bigint) AND (actual_stripe_refund_fee_amount <= '9007199254740991'::bigint)) AND ((actual_stripe_processing_fee_amount >= '-9007199254740991'::bigint) AND (actual_stripe_processing_fee_amount <= '9007199254740991'::bigint)) AND (actual_stripe_processing_fee_amount = (actual_stripe_charge_fee_amount + actual_stripe_refund_fee_amount)) AND ((actual_stripe_charge_net_amount IS NULL) OR ((actual_stripe_charge_net_amount >= '-9007199254740991'::bigint) AND (actual_stripe_charge_net_amount <= '9007199254740991'::bigint))) AND ((actual_stripe_fee_currency IS NULL) OR (actual_stripe_fee_currency = currency)) AND (jsonb_typeof(actual_stripe_charge_fee_details) = 'array'::text))

constraints.name: refunds_actual_stripe_costs

constraints.name: transfer_recovery_requests_amounts

constraints.name: transfer_reversals_allocation

constraints.name: transfers_source_charge_format
